# Custom OpenClaw image with QMD (https://github.com/tobi/qmd) pre-installed.
# QMD = "Query Markup Documents" – an on-device search engine for markdown files.
# OpenClaw uses it as a memory backend (memory.backend: "qmd").
#
# Build: podman build -t openclaw-qmd:latest -f Dockerfile.qmd .
FROM ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest

USER root

# Install deps needed by Bun installer and node-llama-cpp native modules
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      curl unzip ca-certificates build-essential python3 pkg-config libsqlite3-dev make g++ && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Bun for the node user (pinned version for reproducibility)
USER node
ENV BUN_INSTALL="/home/node/.bun"
ARG BUN_VERSION=1.1.43
RUN curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v${BUN_VERSION}"

# Put bun (and globally installed bins like qmd) on PATH
ENV PATH="/home/node/.bun/bin:${PATH}"

# Install QMD globally via Bun (use published npm package to ensure built 'dist' is present)
# Using the npm package ensures the compiled 'dist/qmd.js' is installed and callable.
RUN bun install -g @tobilu/qmd@1.0.6 || bun install -g github:tobi/qmd#${QMD_COMMIT} || true

# Vendor `better-sqlite3` into the app when possible so the gateway can require() it reliably
# Prefer the repo's package manager (pnpm) if available, fall back to npm.
RUN if [ -d "/app" ] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
      cd /app && pnpm add better-sqlite3 --save-prod --no-frozen-lockfile || true; \
    elif [ -d "/app" ]; then \
      cd /app && npm install --no-audit --no-fund better-sqlite3 || true; \
    fi || true

# Ensure native better-sqlite3 binary is rebuilt and available where Node expects it
# - Rebuild in both Bun global install and the app's node_modules (vendor compiled .node into the app)
# - Some installers place compiled .node in build/Release while `bindings` looks under lib/binding/<node-abi>.
RUN set -eux; \
    ABI="node-v$(node -p 'process.versions.modules')-linux-x64"; \
    for DIR in /home/node/.bun/install/global/node_modules/better-sqlite3 /app/node_modules/better-sqlite3; do \
      if [ -d "$DIR" ]; then \
        cd "$DIR"; \
        npm rebuild --build-from-source || true; \
        mkdir -p lib/binding/$ABI; \
        if [ -f build/Release/better_sqlite3.node ]; then \
          cp build/Release/better_sqlite3.node lib/binding/$ABI/better_sqlite3.node || true; \
        fi; \
      fi; \
    done || true

# Verify qmd is available
RUN qmd --help > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: qmd --help failed (may still work at runtime)"

USER node
